dedupe_keys.name: launch power optimization for dynamic elastic optical networks over c l bands

description: Arpanaei, Farhad and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The algorithm chooses launch powers to maximise cumulative link generalised SNR across a C+L channel plan with multiple modulation formats. Coverage includes dynamic elastic-optical-network operation and comparison of exact first-fit and last-fit spectrum placement. The source reports higher average arrival-time GSNR for last-fit under its experiment. The abstract does not expose power bounds, network instances or traffic traces. This is a documented optimisation method, not a configured operational power controller. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
